name: TWL Holdings Berhad
overview: TWL Holdings Berhad 今年通过 TWL Builders Sdn Bhd 以 RM42 million 收购 Fairise Odyssey (M) Sdn Bhd 45% 股权，并拟以 RM26.00 million 收购位于吉隆坡 Jalan Melaka 的 Wisma TWL 商办大楼；同时终止与 Greatprop Development、Elitprop 及 Pentas Irama 的三项合资协议。
overview_en: TWL Holdings Berhad this year acquired a 45% stake in Fairise Odyssey (M) Sdn Bhd for RM42 million via TWL Builders Sdn Bhd, proposed to acquire the Wisma TWL shop/office building at Jalan Melaka, Kuala Lumpur for RM26.00 million, and mutually terminated three joint venture agreements with Greatprop Development, Elitprop and Pentas Irama.

segments.name: 产业发展与建筑
segments.note: 今年终止三项合资协议，并通过 TWL Builders 收购 Fairise Odyssey 股权及拟收购 Wisma TWL 商办大楼。
segments.note_en: This year terminated three joint venture agreements, and via TWL Builders acquired a stake in Fairise Odyssey and proposed to acquire the Wisma TWL shop/office building.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: TWL Builders Sdn Bhd 与 TWL Capital Berhad 签订买卖协议，拟以 RM26.00 million 收购位于吉隆坡 Jalan Melaka 的 Wisma TWL 九层商办大楼（含两层地下室）。
actions.text_en: TWL Builders Sdn Bhd entered into a sale and purchase agreement with TWL Capital Berhad to acquire Wisma TWL, a 9-storey shop/office building with 2 basement levels at Jalan Melaka, Kuala Lumpur, for RM26.00 million.
